title: Morphological Features of Murine Pulmonary Arterial Networks for Diagnosing Vascular Disease
summary: Boosted feature ranking selected a vascular-feature panel and an SVM tested it on micro-CT data from 13 mice; leave-one-out discrimination was about 69%, close to the all-feature result, so this remains exploratory.
